Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG sprite atlas for a top-down pixel-art farm game, Penas pro Ar.
Create ONE redesigned rescue SHEEP character with a complete 12-frame directional walk sprite sheet. The attached chicken sheet is a STYLE reference only: match its clearly stepped pixel edges, warm dark outlines and compact game readability, while giving this sheep much more personality.
Character: fluffy adult ewe, broad ivory wool silhouette with large cloudlike tufts, cocoa face and short cocoa hooves, floppy ears, tiny curious black eyes with one highlight, pink inner ears, a small moss-green neckerchief. Friendly mildly worried expression, a comically proud forelock. Four-legged animal, no hands. Charming chunky 48-to-64-pixel-era game sprite, limited warm palette, clusters of square pixels, 2px outline on virtual pixel grid, three-tone shading. No smooth illustration, no airbrush, no soft gradients, no realistic fur.
Layout is STRICT: portrait 1024x1536 transparent canvas, EXACTLY 3 equal columns and 4 equal rows, one fully separate complete sheep in EACH of the 12 cells. Top row faces DOWN toward camera; second row faces RIGHT; third row faces UP away from camera; bottom row faces LEFT. Each row: column1 neutral standing; column2 walk left legs forward; column3 walk opposite legs forward. Maintain the exact same sheep identity, body size, camera elevation (slightly above, RPG view), light direction, wool pattern and neckerchief in every cell. Feet level within each row, generous transparent gutters, never crop ears or feet. Animal occupies about 65% of its cell width and 60% cell height. True alpha-transparent background, no ground, no shadows, no text, no frame boxes, no numbers, no extra characters. Output only the atlas.
